title_zh: 商定虚构营养课堂材料的表述边界

scenario.label_zh: 商定虚构营养课堂材料的表述边界
scenario.goal_zh: 区分一般肠道知识与个体症状判断，并商定删除保证改善的说法

context_zh: 两名学员修订虚构营养沟通课程的练习材料；不为任何真实患者提供饮食或诊疗建议。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: The handout says that eating more fiber will cure any gut problem. That sounds too certain.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: It is. The course text discusses fiber as part of a varied diet, not as a cure for every symptom.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Could we say that the handout gives general information about food and the digestive system?

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Yes. We should also make clear that it cannot explain an individual person’s symptoms.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: I'll remove the promise of a cure and keep that general description.

sentences.speaker: Rob
sentences.text: Good. We can ask the instructor to check the revised version before it is shared.
